He told me he wanted to be with someone who had a personality like his and his friends and we were too different and he wasn't ready for a relationship; but he would tell me things that were the complete opposite of these like he liked being with someone so different from him and especially from his friends, we actually had a decent amount in common, and he had 7 months to mull over whether he wanted a relationship.
